tagline: 奥林巴斯数码单反相机，2010 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2010年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable (Four Thirds System)。快门速度1/8,000 to 60 s computerized focal plane shutter。

specs.传感器: Four Thirds 17.3 mm x 13.0 mm Live MOS
specs.快门速度: 1/8,000 to 60 s computerized focal plane shutter
specs.闪光灯: built-in pop up flash GN=13 at ISO 100, wireless control for up to 3 external flash groups and 4 channels
specs.取景器: Optical TTL with pentaprism 100% field of view and ×1.15 magnification
specs.屏幕: 3" 920,000 pixel TFT LCD on full articulating multi-angle screen with live preview
specs.电池: Olympus BLM-1 1500 mAh; Olympus BLM-5 1620 mAh Lithium-ion battery
